implemented_in_priority_order: Separate subjective expression/explicit fiction from source-bound factual speech.
Preserve attributed corrected names/preferences per NPC/player and branch under transient chatter.
Select compact memories, stable personality/senses and confirmed perspective history.
Conservatively prune later restatements only after all raw sentences pass validation.
Use connected AI wording for NPC greetings/facts/recall, exact-context validated cache, failed/offline fallback.
Negotiate excessive requested scope through AI wording and bounded decoding without increasing call caps.
remaining_limits: Finite English routing and finite authoritative senses.
Lexical validation can reject valid synonyms and does not establish semantic entailment.
Lexical repetition filtering misses some semantic paraphrases.
Tone can be generic or presumptive; the small cohort is not a general fun/personality benchmark.
Selected claims, operation journal and cache are bounded, not unlimited memory.
